title: Egg White & Black Bean Breakfast Quesadillas
subtitle: Crisp breakfast quesadillas filled with egg whites, black beans, and pepper jack.
description: Egg whites, black beans, and pepper jack get folded into a tortilla and griddled until crisp outside and melted inside. It is a fast, handheld, vegetarian breakfast with a leaner fat profile than a whole-egg quesadilla.

steps.title: Scramble the egg whites
steps.instruction: Cook egg whites in a nonstick skillet over medium-low, stirring gently, until just set. Pull them a little early since they continue to firm up off the heat.

steps.title: Warm the black beans
steps.instruction: Warm black beans in a small saucepan with a splash of water and a pinch of cumin until heated through.

steps.title: Fill the tortillas
steps.instruction: Lay tortillas flat and cover one half with cheese, egg whites, beans, and a spoon of salsa. Fold in half over the filling.

steps.title: Griddle until crisp
steps.instruction: Heat a lightly oiled griddle or skillet over medium. Cook quesadillas 3–4 minutes per side until golden and crisp outside and the cheese has melted through.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 1 minute, then slice into wedges. Serve immediately while the tortilla is still crisp — quesadillas soften fast once stacked.

stationWorkflow: Cook egg whites and beans ahead so assembly and griddling go quickly.
Fill tortillas just before griddling — a filled, unheated quesadilla gets soggy waiting.
Slice each quesadilla right before serving so the crust stays crisp.
cleanupNotes: Wipe the griddle between batches so melted cheese doesn't build up and burn.
Clean the egg white pan while warm for the easiest scrub.
leftovers: Store cooked quesadillas in the fridge up to 3 days.
Reheat in a dry skillet over medium heat to re-crisp rather than microwaving them soft.
